title: In vivo Gene Writing with engineered retrotransposons
title_zh: 利用工程化逆转录转座子进行体内基因写作
abstract: Efficient integration of gene-length cargos in vivo remains challenging. Non-long terminal repeat (non-LTR) retrotransposons, which naturally mobilize large DNA segments through an RNA intermediate, could potentially address these limitations. Here, we developed a computational pipeline to systematically identify a diverse set of non-LTR retrotransposons. Extensive engineering generated elements capable of the efficient and stable insertion of reporter genes in human cells using RNA templates introduced in trans, which we term Gene Writers. Gene Writers successfully generated CD19 and CD20 chimeric antigen receptor T (CAR-T) cells ex vivo with robust antitumor activity. Lipid nanoparticle-mediated RNA delivery enabled in vivo CAR-T cell generation and stable B cell depletion in a humanized mouse model. Our study delineates a comprehensive framework for the discovery, engineering, and application of non-LTR retrotransposons and demonstrates their utility for gene-sized cargo delivery in vivo, thereby bridging a critical gap in existing gene therapy modalities.
abstract_zh: 在体内高效整合基因长度载荷仍是一个挑战。非长末端重复（non-LTR）逆转录转座子天然通过 RNA 中间体移动大段 DNA，可能解决这些限制。我们开发了一套计算流程，系统识别多样的 non-LTR 逆转录转座子。通过广泛工程化，产生了能够在人体细胞中使用转入 RNA 模板高效且稳定插入报告基因的元件，称为 Gene Writers。Gene Writers 成功在体外生成 CD19 和 CD20 嵌合抗原受体 T 细胞（CAR‑T），并表现出强劲的抗肿瘤活性。利用脂质纳米颗粒递送 RNA，实现了体内 CAR‑T 细胞的生成和在人体化小鼠模型中稳定的 B 细胞清除。我们的研究为 non-LTR 逆转录转座子的发现、工程化和应用提供了完整框架，并展示了其在体内递送基因级载荷的实用性，弥补了现有基因治疗方法的关键空白。
